$comment: Listing metadata, applied by scripts/store-metadata.mjs in CI (manager/rules/SEO.md). actorId pins the actor the first deploy created, so CI updates it by ID and a rename of name in actor.json keeps the same actor.
seoTitle: Greenhouse Jobs Scraper - Every Greenhouse Job Board
seoDescription: Search every company on Greenhouse at once: job titles, salary ranges, locations, remote work and posting dates. Live, no login or Greenhouse API key.
defaultRunOptions$comment: Default 1 GB, measured on Apify on 2026-11-03 (build 1.0.1, engine v0.4.0, unpriced): the example input took 185 s, peaked at 255 MB and used $0.0119 (run j96er5Rmn9tfQUkCt); at 2 GB the same input took 119 s, 237 MB, $0.0147 (run YSm3LERZBfd6xSvio); the empty form, the daily test, took 216 s, 278 MB, $0.0137 (run bHR94LfwZ6KKoD9gc). 1 GB gets a quarter CPU core, so a pass is slower but costs less, and at 2 GB the example would leave 89.8% margin without a start fee, under the owner's 90% at every tier. A description search reads the 100 biggest boards 3 at a time at 1 GB (0.88 GB laptop peak) and 10 at a time at 2 GB (1.53 GB laptop peak). minMemoryMbytes 1024: at 512 MB a pass would get an eighth of a core, and a maxJobs 0 run (669 MB laptop peak) would not fit.

pricing.$comment: 2026-11-02, run start added 2026-11-03. Rule: rules/SEO.md section 16. Main competitor: fantastic-jobs/greenhouse-jobs-api, the most used actor made for Greenhouse (156 u30): $0.002 a job on FREE and BRONZE, $0.0012 on SILVER and above, no start fee, one row with the description from its own database. job is 10% under it and job-details 5% under it on FREE and BRONZE. Others: bovi $0.0015 + $0.00005 start (company slugs or preset lists), yugenox $0.002 (live keyword search, Greenhouse, Lever and Ashby), bytepulselabs $0.002 (board links), automation-lab $0.002 + $0.01 start, jobo.world $0.004 (database). Run start: Apify's apify-actor-start at $0.01 per GB, $0.01 at the default 1 GB, because every search reads all 8,357 boards whatever it finds: $0.0119 to $0.0137 of platform usage a run at 1 GB on Apify (runs j96er5Rmn9tfQUkCt and bHR94LfwZ6KKoD9gc, 2026-11-03), 87-88% of it compute; billed external transfer was 4.6 to 4.8 MB (under $0.001) although a run receives about 30 MB. Margin rule (owner): platform cost under 10% of developer revenue (0.8 x price) at every tier. 100 rows with the run start: example 92.2% on FREE and 93.5% on GOLD, empty form 91.0% and 92.5%. Those competitors charge no start fee, so a run under 50 jobs (100 with details) costs a little more here, which the README says. Gentle ladder per the owner's decision of 2026-10-29. apply true; isPublic stays false until the priced proof run.

job.eventDescription: One saved job row: title, company, locations, work type, job type, pay, posting date, deadline, job link. Also one checked job link that is closed or not found.

job-details.eventDescription: One saved job row with full details on: everything in a Job row plus the description as text and HTML, the department, the company's reference number and pay as numbers with its currency.

apify-actor-start.eventDescription: Charged by Apify when a run starts: once up to 1 GB of memory and once more for each extra GB, so $0.01 at the default 1 GB. It pays for reading all of Greenhouse's 8,357 job boards, which every search does whatever it finds.
